preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT venta_id, tipo_comprobante_id FROM comprobante WHERE pago_id IS NULL AND estado = 'EMITIDO' GROUP BY venta_id, tipo_comprobante_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicated_active_sale_receipts

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT pago_id, tipo_comprobante_id FROM comprobante WHERE pago_id IS NOT NULL AND estado = 'EMITIDO' GROUP BY pago_id, tipo_comprobante_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicated_active_payment_receipts
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comprobante WHERE pago_id IS NOT NULL AND venta_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comprobante WHERE tipo_comprobante_id IS NULL

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE comprobante ADD COLUMN venta_emitida_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN estado = 'EMITIDO' AND pago_id IS NULL THEN venta_id ELSE NULL END ) STORED, ADD COLUMN pago_emitido_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN estado = 'EMITIDO' AND pago_id IS NOT NULL THEN pago_id ELSE NULL END ) STORED
